title: A Oath for the Hollow
author: Rafael Reyes
blurb: Kestrel Iversen, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
